question: Which of the following companies built Fort St George in Chennai in the 1640s and later established the Madras Presidency in 1684?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**British East India Company**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **British East India Company** established **Fort St George** in Chennai (formerly Madras) in the **1640s**.
 
• Fort St George became the foundation of the colonial city of Madras, now known as **Chennai**.
